summary: Replaced the blocked OpenAI Research HTML-index discovery path with OpenAI's first-party News RSS feed and a deterministic Research-category adapter. The adapter admits only dated entries tagged Research, preserves RSS provenance and existing title/URL rules, records source-specific discovery diagnostics, and fails safely without a bypass when the feed is malformed or unavailable. Evidence: commit bc03498; uv run pytest tests/test_discovery.py tests/test_observability.py -> 26 passed; uv run pytest -> 86 passed; ProductSpec validation and graph checks passed; live 7-day discovery returned no candidates because no qualifying Research post was published in the window; live 30-day discovery returned the July 8 coding-evaluations post and June 30 GeneBench-Pro; GitHub Actions run 30178695930 completed successfully at https://github.com/fullstackpm-ai/ai-intuition/actions/runs/30178695930.
